Legend has it that a lost tribe of dwarves settled on an island near Yalahar. Discover the hidden city of {wiki:Beregar|Beregar} beneath Fenrock and help its inhabitants in a series of missions: repair the elevator, prove {npc:Nokmir}'s innocence, deliver a chocolate cake, save the emperor's son from the trolls and bribe a guard with beer. You get access to the Beregar mines, {item:Dwarven Legs}, {item:Rusted Armor}, {item:Crystal of Focus}, {item:Gold Ingot}, {item:Small Topaz|Small Topazes} and, at level 100, the {item:Firewalker Boots}.
First part of the quest: talk about Mistrock with {npc:Maris} once you are in Mistrock ({key:mistrock}) and use the {item:Pick} on the crack in the Fenrock cave.
You need Premium and access to Yalahar.
Ore cart between the start of the path (Fenrock) and Beregar
On your first visit, when you activate the cart on the yellow floor south of {npc:Nokmir}.

East mine with *Going Down* ({npc:Xorlosh}'s elevator); north mine with *Justice for All* ({npc:Nokmir}'s door); west mine with *Sweet as Chocolate Cake* ({npc:Frafnar}); south mine with *The Good Guard* ({npc:Grombur}).
